Package cafe94.system.controller.customer

Class OrderingController

java.lang.Object
cafe94.system.controller.customer.OrderingController
public class OrderingController extends Object
Controller for the Ordering view in the Cafe94 system.

This controller allows customers (or staff on behalf of customers) to browse the menu and daily specials, add items to a basket, and place takeaway or delivery orders. It handles item selection, basket management, total calculation, and order confirmation.

Features include:
  • Dynamic loading of menu and daily specials
  • Basket management (add/remove items, subtotal tracking)
  • Takeaway and delivery order creation with validation
  • Popup confirmation with editable delivery/pickup info
  • Data persistence of confirmed orders
Integrates with OrderManaged, DataSaver, and SceneManager to ensure consistent application state and persistence.

    • setup

      public void setup(Customer customer, OrderManaged orderManaged, List<MenuItem> menuItems, List<MenuItem> dailySpecials)
      Sets up the ordering view with the current customer, order manager, and menu data. This method is typically called after scene loading to initialize content before interaction.
      Parameters:
      customer - The logged-in customer placing the order.
      orderManaged - The shared order manager instance.
      menuItems - The full list of available menu items.
      dailySpecials - The list of current daily specials.

    • applySetup

      private void applySetup()
      Populates menu and specials tables once both the controller and scene are initialized. Called from `initialize()` or `setup()` depending on execution order.
